name: daily4
structure: kishōtenketsu (起承転結) — conflict-free 4-panel daily-life arc
use_for: morning routines, meals, commutes, weather, chores, small misunderstandings

beats.goal: Establish the setting and the character's state. A scene preset (bedroom/kitchen/street) plus one character. Dialogue is optional — a thought bubble with an inner remark works well here.
Deepen the situation without changing it: a second character enters, a small action, a routine continues. Introduce the everyday object the strip is about (coffee, umbrella, cat, train).
Recontextualize panels 1-2 with a surprise that is still everyday-scale: the item is missing, the day is wrong, someone remembered the wrong thing. Reaction FX (fx/em, fx/sweat, fx/q) belong here.
Resolve the twist calmly — the punchline lands by tying back to panel 1. A two-shot of both characters facing each other is the classic closer.

example_dialogue.text: Relax. It got rained out anyway.
